title: Liveframe slab telemetry, adaptive tracing spans, and dynamic redaction for streamed outputs
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Produce a production-ready telemetry model and runtime hooks for streaming API responses that capture per-slab metrics, create adaptive tracing spans for tool/function calls and structured output boundaries, and apply dynamic log-redaction without breaking low-latency streaming.

Scope:
- Define 'liveframe slab' as the atomic telemetry unit for streaming outputs (variable token window sized by latency SLO and tool boundary).
- Emit per-slab metrics (tokens, latency_ms, bytes_out, drop_reason, model_variant) and correlate to a top-level request id and to any tool/function call IDs.
- Create adaptive tracing spans that open/close based on slab boundaries, structured-output delimiters (JSON blocks), and function/tool call boundaries. Spans must be linkable to existing request traces in X-Ray/Jaeger.
- Implement a streaming redaction transform that masks PII on the fly using a deterministic grammar-aware matcher with a configurable risk threshold, configurable per-customer. Redaction must: (a) run as a non-blocking stage, (b) be reversible for audit logs when KMS unlocked (enterprise-only), and (c) emit redaction metadata (type, location, slab_id) as separate telemetry events.
- Provide a compatibility shim so legacy clients (no streaming tracing headers) receive minimal per-slab metrics via periodic hygenic events while preserving the main streaming surface.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not change batching strategies or KV-cache behavior. It focuses on telemetry and redaction in the streaming path only.

Design summary and trade-offs:
1) Slab sizing: we will default to a latency-first slab (max 200ms or 128 tokens) to keep latency SLOs and produce stable histograms. Larger slabs reduce telemetry traffic but increase variance for WPS metrics. We will make slab_size tunable per-customer via route config.
2) Adaptive spans: start/finish spans at slab boundaries and specially mark spans that contain structured-output block starts (e.g., <JSON_START>) or function-call enter/exit. This keeps spans aligned to developer-facing semantics but increases span churn. Sampling will be used for high-throughput customers.
3) Redaction pipeline: implement a streaming state machine with a small lookahead buffer to handle multi-token PII patterns (credit card, SSN). The buffer size is capped to limit memory. For enterprise reversible-redaction, redact stream into two parallel outputs: (1) client stream with masked tokens, (2) encrypted audit stream stored in S3 with KMS-wrapped key. This doubles write bandwidth for audit-enabled customers—documented trade-off.
4) Backpressure and latency: the redaction/telemetry stages will be implemented as async fibers in the runtime with backpressure propagation to the I/O layer. If redaction overload occurs, fall back to a faster-safe mode (token-level heuristic mask) and emit an 'overload' telemetry tag.

Compatibility considerations:
- Legacy clients: inject X-Compat-Slab header when stream handshake lacks tracing headers. Provide a 'compat-mode' flag in route config.
- SDKs: add new streaming event types to SDKs (slab_start, slab_end, redaction_event, tool_call_span). Maintain backward-compatible enums.

Acceptance criteria:
- Per-slab telemetry events emitted for 95% of streamed requests in e2e test harness.
- Traces show adaptive span boundaries aligning with function/tool call enter/exit in integration tests with mocked tool calls.
- Redaction pipeline masks all CRS-annotated PII patterns in the regression prompt set at 99% recall and emits redaction metadata.
- Fall-back safe-mode triggered and observable under simulated overload in load test.
- Documentation: console docs + SDK changelog updated and example dashboard saved in Grafana for slab metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Emit slab_start and slab_end telemetry events with request_id and slab_id for 95% of streams in CI harness
Adaptive tracing spans are created for tool-call boundaries and JSON structured-output blocks in integration test traces
Redaction pipeline masks annotated PII at >=99% recall on regression prompt set and publishes redaction_event telemetry
Fallback safe-mode activates and sets telemetry tag when redaction stage latency > 120ms
Documentation and dashboard added: Grafana slab latency histogram, redaction rate, tool-call span counts
